inputs.prompt: Create a character sprite sheet of the character in the reference image: a 4-frame side-view walk cycle, facing right. Arrange the 4 frames in a 2x2 grid of equal square cells, reading left to right, top to bottom. Keep the exact same character design, colors, proportions and outfit in every frame; only the pose changes to form a smooth looping walk (contact, down, passing, up). Clean 3D cartoon game-asset style, full body visible in each cell, character centered, consistent scale, plain flat white background, no text, no labels, no grid lines.
